WEEKFORM

Build a week that can breathe.

Pick a frequency. Pin must-train days. Forbid impossible days.

  1. Every valid seven-day week is generated, including plans with tighter spacing.
  2. Weeks are ordered by the fewest adjacent workout pairs, then by the most even rest gaps.
  3. Sunday and Monday count as neighbours. Unavailable days stay in the week as rest.

Adjacent means a workout on two consecutive days. Nothing is filtered out.
